references.text: Continuation of the law concerning an open pit, which describes liability when an animal falls into the well
Similar principle of responsibility for damage caused by negligence
The law requiring a railing on the roof to prevent someone from falling down, based on the same principle of preventing harm
Previous laws regarding liability when an ox injures people or animals, part of the same collection of laws concerning compensation
Liability for damage when livestock graze on another's field, addressing the same theme of compensation for negligence
